quotes: Growth rarely feels like growth while it's happening. Most of the time it just feels like being uncomfortable.
The path that scares you a little is usually the one that's meant for you.
You can't keep doing what you've always done and expect to feel something new. Change starts where comfort ends.
Be patient with the version of you that's still learning. They're doing the hard part so you don't have to later.
posts.caption:
Discomfort isn't a sign you're lost. It's usually a sign you're growing. 🌱

Save this for the days that feel heavy.

quotes: Some things leave your life so better things have room to arrive.
Holding on can look like loyalty. Sometimes it's just fear wearing a nicer coat.
You don't have to understand why it ended to accept that it did.
Letting go isn't losing. It's choosing your peace over the past.
posts.caption:
You're allowed to set it down. 🍃

Send this to someone who needs to hear it today.

quotes: Nobody notices the quiet mornings you showed up anyway. But your future does.
You don't need a new life. You need a few small habits you keep when no one is watching.
Slow progress is still progress. A step a day is a mile by spring.
Discipline is just remembering what you want more than what you feel like right now.
posts.caption:
Small steps, every day. That's the whole secret. 🪷

What's one small thing you'll do today?

quotes: You are allowed to end the day without having figured everything out.
Not every worry deserves a place in your night. Some can wait until morning.
Peace isn't the absence of problems. It's deciding they don't get to sit at your table tonight.
Breathe out slowly. You got through today, and that was enough.
posts.caption:
Put the day down. You did enough. 🌙

Send this to someone who needs rest tonight.
